notes.title: Updated February 25th
notes.notes:
[b]Update[/b]

-The puzzle and some hint texts have been modified.

-The movement speed of players and monsters has been slightly adjusted.

-Default sound volume has been increased.

-The duration of the candles has been increased.

[b]Fix[/b]

-Fixing the issue with the player's movement speed changing.

-Addressing the artifacts that appear at the edges when rotating the camera.

-Fixing the issue where the HUD appears in the middle of the screen during the intro cutscene.
